articles.title: NXP Microcontroller Selection Guide
articles.summary: Comprehensive guide for selecting the right NXP microcontroller for automotive and industrial applications.
articles.content:
Selecting the right microcontroller is critical for the success of your embedded design. This guide helps you navigate NXP's microcontroller portfolio.

## NXP MCU Portfolio Overview

### S32K Series (Automotive)
- ARM Cortex-M4F/M7 cores
- Up to 2MB Flash, 256KB RAM
- CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet
- AEC-Q100 qualified
- ASIL-B support

### LPC Series (General Purpose)
- ARM Cortex-M0+/M3/M4 cores
- Cost-effective solutions
- Rich peripheral set
- Low power options

### i. MX RT Series (Crossover)
- High-performance Cortex-M7
- Up to 600MHz
- Advanced graphics capabilities
- External memory interface

## Selection Criteria

### Performance Requirements
- Core type and speed
- Memory size (Flash/RAM)
- DSP capabilities
- Floating-point unit

### Connectivity
- Communication interfaces (CAN, LIN, Ethernet, USB)
- Number of serial ports
- Wireless connectivity

### Analog Features
- ADC resolution and channels
- DAC availability
- Comparator inputs

### Power and Reliability
- Operating voltage range
- Power consumption
- Temperature range
- Quality qualification (AEC-Q100)
